subject.title: fix: setup fails closed for invalid configuration arguments

question: Should SetupEngine globally reject duplicate value options, replacing the previous first-value-wins behavior for existing unattended scripts?
rationale: The parser hardening is valuable, but this specific behavior change affects syntactically valid established invocations and cannot be classified as a purely mechanical security repair without deciding the supported CLI contract.

options.title: Preserve duplicate compatibility
options.body: Retain first-value-wins for duplicate value options while continuing to reject unknown, positional, malformed, and missing-value arguments.

options.title: Adopt strict duplicate rejection
options.body: Keep exit-code-2 rejection for all duplicate value options and explicitly accept the resulting breaking CLI contract for existing scripts.

recommendation.title: Preserve duplicate compatibility
recommendation.body: Retain first-value-wins for duplicate value options while continuing to reject unknown, positional, malformed, and missing-value arguments.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing review context under this account already identified duplicate-value behavior as the remaining setup-contract decision.
